components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button. Understated on gray; review for yellow fill on brand-facing pages.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.9 0 0); color: oklch(0.1 0 0); border: none; padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.7 0 0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.3 0 0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.3 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(0.7 0 0); padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.1s, color 0.1s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.9 0 0); color: oklch(0.1 0 0); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.3 0 0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions only: delete prescription, hard-delete confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: oklch(0.55 0.22 25); color: oklch(1 0 0); border: none; padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.1s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: oklch(0.45 0.22 25); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.22 25); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field — label stacked above, 42px height.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-label { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(0.1 0 0); } .ds-input { height: 42px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.7 0 0); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 1rem; font-family: Georgia, serif; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: #fff; color: oklch(0.1 0 0); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.3 0 0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 12px 24px; background: oklch(0.9 0.4 95); border-bottom: 2px solid oklch(0.87 0.36 95); } .ds-header-brand { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; color: oklch(0.1 0 0); text-decoration: none; } .ds-header-nav { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: center; margin-left: auto; } .ds-header-nav a { color: oklch(0.1 0 0); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-header-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-header-logout { background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; color: oklch(0.1 0 0); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 0; } .ds-header-logout:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

components.name: Day Pill Toggle
components.description: Day-of-week checkbox toggle. The most expressive component in the system — physical, tactile, warm.
components.css: .ds-day-pill { display: flex; cursor: pointer; } .ds-day-pill span { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; padding: 6px 2px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.7 0 0); background: oklch(0.97 0 0); color: oklch(0.3 0 0); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; user-select: none; box-shadow: 0 2px 3px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.18), 0 1px 1px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1); transition: background 0.1s, color 0.1s, border-color 0.1s, box-shadow 0.1s; } .ds-day-pill:has(input:checked) span { background: oklch(0.52 0.17 220); border-color: oklch(0.52 0.17 220); color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 3px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.25); } .ds-visually-hidden { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }

components.name: Fill Session Card
components.description: Expandable medication card showing the weekly pill-organizer grid. Signature component.
components.css: .ds-fill-card { border: 1px solid oklch(0.9 0 0); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-fill-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; background: oklch(0.95 0.06 95); border: none; width: 100%; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-fill-card-header--open { border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.9 0 0); } .ds-fill-card-drug-name { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(0.1 0 0); } .ds-fill-card-drug-dosage { font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.5 0 0); } .ds-fill-card-total { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(0.1 0 0); margin-inline-start: auto; } .ds-fill-card-caret { font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(0.5 0 0); transform: rotate(180deg); flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Pillbug is a personal tool built for the rhythms of real daily life — refilling the pill organizer on Sunday evening, checking off the 8am dose before leaving the house, looking up a prescription detail at the pharmacy. The interface is always there when you need it, never in the way when you don't. It earns trust not by announcing itself, but by being consistently reliable and warm.

The visual language is deliberately approachable. Georgia serif body text gives the app a human, slightly old-fashioned warmth — more like a trusted notebook than a clinical portal. Golden yellow grounds the identity without demanding attention; playful sky blue signals interaction and life. Together they say: this was made for a person, by someone who cares.

This system rejects three families of design by name: clinical/hospital UI (cold blue-and-white EHR forms), wellness/spa styling (soft gradients, pastel greens, mindfulness-app vibes), and gamified health tracking (streaks, badges, progress bars). Medication management is serious and personal; the interface meets that with warmth and clarity, not performance.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, not clinical; personal, not institutional
Typography carries personality (serif body reads as human and editorial)
Golden yellow as brand anchor; sky blue as interactive counterpoint
Expressive and rounded in components, never boxy or flat-corporate
Privacy by default: minimal information on screen unless the patient actively chooses more
WCAG AA floor, readability over elegance, designed for older users and all visual ranges

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Alert Red is reserved for destructive and irreversible actions only. Never use red to signal 'important but not dangerous.'

rules.name: The No Pastel Rule
rules.body: Tinted neutrals are always achromatic (chroma 0) or very faintly hued (chroma ≤0.04). Never add warmth or coolness to neutral backgrounds — 'warm neutral' is the AI-slop cliché this system explicitly rejects.

rules.name: The Serif Body Rule
rules.body: Georgia is not a legacy fallback — it is the deliberate voice of the app. Don't replace it with system-ui or Inter for body copy.

rules.name: The Playful Display Horizon
rules.body: Coiny, Sour Gummy, and Short Stack are the aspirational direction for display headings on public-facing screens. Until loaded, system-ui holds the position.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces don't float unless they physically need to. If you're adding box-shadow to a new component, ask whether it's structurally necessary or just decorative.

dos: Use Georgia serif for all body copy. It is the personality, not a legacy fallback.
Use OKLCH for all color definitions. The token system is OKLCH-only.
Use sky blue (oklch(0.52 0.17 220)) for interactive text and link states.
Keep button labels as verb + object: 'Save changes', 'Delete prescription', 'Add dose time'.
Verify ≥4.5:1 contrast for all body text before using muted text on any non-white surface.
Design for privacy by default: sensitive information hidden unless patient actively shows it.
Use the day-pill pattern (rounded checkbox toggles) when selecting days of the week.
donts: Don't introduce a clinical or hospital UI aesthetic: cold blue-and-white, EHR-style dense form layouts.
Don't use soft gradients, pastel greens, or mindfulness-app styling.
Don't add game mechanics: streaks, badges, points, progress bars framed as achievement.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent on cards or callouts.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Single solid color only.
Don't use the cream/sand/beige warm-neutral background (OKLCH L 0.84–0.97, chroma < 0.06, hue 40–100).
Don't default to system-ui for all text. Georgia is the body font and is non-negotiable for paragraph copy.
Don't put the same tiny all-caps tracked eyebrow above every section.
